// dir: x
// want: x: other is not a constant
// with: core
package x

import "github.com/0b1-PulsarTech/pulsarules_codex/internal/analyzer/core"

func run(ctx core.AnalysisContext, other string) {
	params := ctx.Params("file-size")
	if other != "" {
		params = ctx.Params(other)
	}
	_ = params.Int("max_lines", 1)
}
